text: The purpose of this report is to provide City Council with the Operating Variance results for the four months ended April 30, 2026, as well as projections to the year-end. This report also requests City Council's approval for amendments to the 2026 Approved Operating Budget that have no impact on the City's Net Budget. The following table summarizes the year-to-date financial position and year-end projections for the City's Tax-Supported Operations as of April 30, 2026.
